import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    if not data:
        return

    n = int(data[0])
    if n == 0:
        return

    best_name = ""
    best_value = -1
    idx = 1

    for _ in range(n):
        name = data[idx].decode()
        value = int(data[idx + 1])

        if value > best_value:
            best_value = value
            best_name = name

        idx += 2

    sys.stdout.write(best_name + "\n" + str(best_value) + "\n")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
